title: Novo Token — Direct LP transferFrom Drain Analysis
root_cause: NOVO token's `transferFrom()` function does not validate the allowance for the `from` parameter, allowing anyone to arbitrarily transfer tokens held by the LP pool
steps: ⚡ No allowance check → drain all NOVO from LP
→ NOVO price manipulation (NOVO in LP decreases → price rises)
Swap at manipulated high price → realize profit
